checks: Authenticated backend config exposes version, explicit presets and no guessed default
New wallet remains Mainnet and Fulcrum preset uses plaintext TCP port 50002
Electrs preset uses the exported node IP and port
Custom TLS endpoint remains explicitly entered and is not replaced by a preset
Connection button traverses real HTTP and Electrum protocol checks and reports verified Mainnet height
Wrong genesis produces a helpful Regtest versus Mainnet error
Changing wallet network clears stale result and matching Regtest verifies
Editing URL during an in-flight probe suppresses stale success
Selecting another preset clears previous connection result
Explicit repair replaces only the legacy bad default and saving retains existing wallet ID
Existing custom local hostname URL is preserved without suggesting or applying automatic repair
Custom URL change persists to the original wallet registry entry with no additional wallet
scope: Actual dashboard frontend, authentication, wallet registry and Electrum checker exercised in isolated Chrome with disposable local Electrum protocol fixtures. No native daemon launched and no user backend contacted.
